annotations.title: Put a brand on the bio page

description: Adds an accepted program to the bio page as a link with its code (or turns its link back on): the brand's tracking link, else its site. Clicks on it count toward results_get. To group several products, use bio_collection_save with program_id.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
